title: C-STRIDE: An Observation-Driven AI Digital Twin for Predicting Basin-Wide Flood Fields from Sparse Stream-Gauge Histories
abstract: arXiv:2609.39005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emergency managers need to know where floodwater is, how deep it is, and how it will change over the coming hours across an entire river basin. During a flood, however, real-time measurements come from only a handful of stream gauges, and high-resolution hydrodynamic models are too costly to rerun each time new data arrive or to run as large ensembles. We present C-STRIDE, an observation-driven AI digital twin that turns short records from a few stream gauges, together with terrain and rainfall, into basin-wide maps of water depth and extends these predictions up to a day ahead. It is trained on simulations from a calibrated two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and needs no separate data-assimilation step. In the Des Plaines River basin near Chicago, six gauges inform predictions over 4.2 million 30-m grid cells. Terrain improves the predictions most, rainfall keeps errors from growing over longer horizons, and together they reduce errors

translated_title: C-STRIDE：一种观测驱动的AI数字孪生，用于从稀疏的水位计历史数据预测全流域洪水场
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.39005v1 Announce Type: new。应急管理者需要知道洪水位于何处、水深多少，以及未来几个小时内整个流域的洪水将如何演变。然而在洪水期间，实时测量数据仅来自少数几个水位计，而高分辨率水动力学模型在每次新数据到达时重新运行的成本过高，也难以进行大规模集合模拟。我们提出了C-STRIDE，这是一种观测驱动的AI数字孪生系统，它能够将来自少量水位计的短时记录，结合地形和降雨信息，转化为全流域水深分布图，并将预测延伸至未来一天。该系统基于经过校准的二维水动力学模型的模拟数据进行训练，无需单独的数据同化步骤。在芝加哥附近的德斯普兰斯河流域，六个水位计即可为超过420万个30米网格单元提供预测。地形对预测的改进贡献最大，降雨能够防止误差在更长预测时段内增长，两者结合可降低误差（原文在此处截断）
tldr: C-STRIDE是一种观测驱动的AI数字孪生系统，仅利用少量水位计的稀疏历史记录结合地形与降雨信息，即可预测全流域未来一天内的水深分布地图，且无需单独的数据同化步骤。
en_tdlr: C-STRIDE is an observation-driven AI digital twin that predicts basin-wide flood depth maps up to a day ahead using only sparse stream-gauge records combined with terrain and rainfall, without requiring a separate data-assimilation step.
